title: Claude Agent SDK & Managed Agents
content:
## Overview

The **Claude Agent SDK** is Anthropic's framework for building production-grade agentic applications. Alongside a major platform overhaul in 2026, it ships primitives for long-running agents, persistent cross-session memory, multi-agent coordination, and enterprise-grade secure infrastructure.

---

## What Is a Managed Agent?

A **Managed Agent** runs on Anthropic-managed infrastructure rather than a developer-hosted server. Key properties:

- **Scheduled execution** — agents run on cron-like schedules, firing at defined intervals to complete recurring work automatically
- **Authenticated tool access** — agents can invoke CLI tools and connect to private services via MCP tunnels without requiring the session to be open
- **Session isolation** — each scheduled run starts a fresh session, but persistent state is available via the Dreaming feature (see below)

---

## Code with Claude 2026: Five Major Features

At the "Code with Claude 2026" developer conference, Anthropic shipped five major Agent SDK capabilities:

### Dreaming

Managed default for persistent cross-session memory. Previously, maintaining state between agent sessions required custom database logic. Dreaming makes this automatic: agents accumulate knowledge and refine skills across runs without manual engineering.

**Use case:** A nightly data-sync agent that learns from previous failures which data sources are flaky and adjusts its retry strategy over time.

### Outcomes

Addresses the evaluation problem: how do you know when an agent's output is actually good enough? Outcomes provides a structured framework for defining success criteria upfront and automatically verifying results before delivery. This prevents agents from returning technically-complete but practically-wrong outputs.

### Multi-Agent Orchestration

A **lead agent** breaks a job into pieces and delegates each to **specialist sub-agents** with their own models, prompts, and tools. Sub-agents work in parallel on a shared file system.

As of June 2026, sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents up to **5 levels deep**, enabling complex hierarchical task decomposition. Example pipeline:

```
Coordinator
├── Research Agent
│   ├── Web Search Sub-Agent
│   └── Document Analysis Sub-Agent
├── Code Agent
│   ├── Implementation Sub-Agent
│   └── Test-Writing Sub-Agent
└── Review Agent
```

### Ultra Code

A specialized coding mode using **fan-out**, adversarial verification, and tournament patterns. Multiple sub-agents independently tackle the same coding problem; their solutions are automatically compared and the best one is selected. This dramatically improves output quality on complex engineering tasks.

### Claude Finance

Ten pre-built agents for financial workflows, including SEC filing research, earnings analysis, and market data aggregation. Grounded in richer SEC data via the updated web search tool, which now returns structured SEC filing data with citations.

---

## Enterprise Security

### Self-Hosted Sandboxes

Managed Agents now support execution within **your own infrastructure** — agent sandboxes can run inside your VPC, meeting data-residency and compliance requirements.

### MCP Tunnels

Agents reach private MCP servers inside enterprise networks without exposing them to the public internet. A lightweight gateway makes a single outbound connection with end-to-end encrypted traffic — no inbound firewall rules required.

### Identity-Based Authentication

Agents authenticate using the identity they already have:

- AWS IAM roles
- GCP service accounts
- Azure managed identity
- GitHub Actions tokens
- Okta / other OIDC-compliant providers

### Enterprise MCP Connectors

Anthropic added centrally-managed MCP connector provisioning, starting with Okta. Admins provision the connector once; users get zero-touch access on first login with authorization configured centrally.

---

## Billing Model (Effective June 15, 2026)

Anthropic split Claude plans into two separate billing pools: one for Claude.ai usage and one for Agent SDK API usage.

| Plan | Agent SDK Credits / Month |
|---|---|
| Pro | $20 |
| Max 5x | $100 |
| Max 20x | $200 |

Agent SDK credits cover API calls made when building and running agents. This split was temporarily paused around the June 15 deadline and then reinstated.

---

## Claude Code Deep Sub-Agent Nesting

In addition to the Agent SDK features, **Claude Code** (the CLI/IDE tool) received several related improvements in June 2026:

- Deeper sub-agent nesting support (up to 5 levels, matching the SDK)
- Smarter AWS region detection for cloud-integrated workflows
- A searchable plugin marketplace for discovering MCP server integrations
- Several model and session stability fixes

---

## SDK Architecture

The Agent SDK is available as Python and TypeScript libraries that wrap the Claude Messages API with higher-level abstractions:

```python
from claude_agent_sdk import Agent, ManagedRunner

agent = Agent(
    model="claude-sonnet-4-6",
    tools=[...],
    memory="dreaming"  # enables persistent cross-session memory
)

runner = ManagedRunner(schedule="0 9 * * *")  # daily at 9am
runner.deploy(agent)
```

For workloads that don't need managed scheduling, the SDK also works as a lightweight wrapper for local agentic loops.
